execution: one fresh engine process at a time; five alternating baseline/candidate repeats; CPU 0 affinity; no simultaneous match or compile on that CPU
failure_policy: If no bestmove by 2 s, send stop; observe for at most 1 s, then terminate only the owned child if needed. Preserve every timeout, stderr, abnormal exit, and output. No retries replacing failed repeats.
capture: every UCI input/output line with UTC and monotonic timestamp
2 s expiry and explicit stop latency
process exit and owned-child termination if required
state_limitations: All repeats start with a new process and ucinewgame. Board/repetition history is reconstructed by the exact original position command. Prior search-generated TT/history state is unavailable, so this is not an exact warm-state reproduction. Event timestamps are observer receive/write times, not engine-internal syscall timestamps.
